function: above_phy (pp. 7-8): DSAC reinforcement learning decides UAV-user and UAV-satellite pairing, UAV trajectory, inter-satellite link use and semantic transmission mode; transmit power and bandwidth are fixed (p. 9).
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 7: "The optimization variables include UAV-user pairing, UAV trajectory planning, UAV-satellite pairing, whether to transmit through ISLs to other satellites, and the selection of hybrid bit and semantic transmission modes." p. 8: the DSAC action is a(t) = {R(t), O(t), L(t), Y(t), ε(t)}. p. 2 defines the 'resource allocation' of the title as "UAV dynamic planning, UAV-satellite and UAV-ground user pairing, and inter-satellite transmission relationships". These are user association, UAV trajectory, routing over inter-satellite links, and a choice of image source coding (JPEG 2000 or semantic modes, pp. 5-8). No radio resource, power or beam is learned: p. 9 "the transmit powers of LEOs and UAVs are 1 W and 0.2 W" and "the bandwidth for all transmissions is 10 MHz"; satellite power is only swept as a parameter (Fig. 10, p. 11). The other learned parts (VQE and diffusion UNet, pp. 5-6) are digital semantic source coding, whose codeword is "transmitted after source-channel encoding" (p. 6). If the mode selection were read as a physical-layer decision, the work would still be excluded under function (semantic coding and link adaptation are outside the seven areas). The PDF is arXiv:2412.05647v3 (p. 1), titled 'Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Resource Allocation for Hybrid Bit and Generative Semantic Communications in Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks'; it prints no DOI, so its match with the DOI could not be checked in the file.
